name: James Clerk Maxwell Telescope
scope: The James Clerk Maxwell Telescope exterior on the Maunakea summit, including the rotating cylindrical enclosure, roof shutter, stationary bearing ring and mapped entry hut.
era: Operating observatory exterior, with the enclosure and shutter in one fixed representative position.

originalReview.notes: A. Woodcraft, 5 June 2008, exact original. The central white carousel shows its raised roof rim, recess and rail ends, shadowed bearing, and the low fixed base and entry. The other observatories visible in the photograph are outside this scope.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with the exact A. Woodcraft public-domain original already published on Qualla. The surveyed ground and mapped footprint establish the entrance elevation and position.
